explication: ArcKit is an AI-assisted enterprise architecture governance toolkit. Its principal workflow is architects using an assistant or CLI to create and manage project artefacts, then inspect project context, traceability, and governance status; the README also documents research, planning, design, procurement, and assurance capabilities. The repository includes integrations for several assistants and a Paperclip tool plugin. Some major command-level capabilities are documented but their implementation files are absent from the supplied tree, so the graph shows the sampled runtime components and only documented or evidenced relationships.
